newsitem.title: USA: Brandywine Realty files for shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Brandywine Realty files for shr offering.

text.p: Brandywine Realty Trust filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 8.0 million common shares under its shelf registration statement.
Proceeds will be used to repay advances under the company's credit lines and for working capital purposes, Brandywine said in a statement.
The company intends to grant the underwriters an option to purchase an additional 1,200,000 shares to cover over-allotments, Brandywine said. All of the shares are being offered by the company.
Smith Barney Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenerette Securities Corp, Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co will act as underwriters for the proposed offering.
